text:
Nina: Quick heads-up from user testing: when a modal opens and a toast appears the toast steals keyboard events (Esc) and sometimes closes the modal unexpectedly. Figma: https://figma.com/file/modal-stack-ux Theo: Oh no. That sounds like our global key handler is catching events before modal handlers. We should ensure the modal is topmost and that global toast handlers check z-index/activeElement before acting. Elena: UX suggestion: toasts should still appear while modals are open but be visually de-emphasized (lower contrast) and never intercept focus or Esc. They should be non-interactive by default when a modal is active. Sam: Implementation idea: add an API flag `dismissOnEsc: boolean` on the toast component and the platform can set it to false when a modal is mounted (or when focus trap is active). Also register the Esc handler on the toast node and call stopPropagation() only when the toast itself has focus. Nina: Good. For animations, let's avoid entrance motion while a modal is open to reduce distraction. Also respect `prefers-reduced-motion` always. Theo: Also ran into clipped focus rings in compact table modes when a modal is shown. If we add overlaying toasts we need to ensure focus outlines have enough space or use inset outlines. Elena: Copy notes: shorten modal success toasts to a single word: "Saved" or "Published". For actions inside modals (e.g., "Discard changes") keep exact phrasing and don't duplicate in the toast. If it's actionable, show an explicit action inside the modal instead of the toast. Sam: Layering tokens proposal: token.layer.modal = 10000, token.layer.popover = 9800, token.layer.toast = 9500, token.layer.tooltip = 9900. Tooltips should supersede toasts so they don't get hidden. I'll add to the token docs. Nina: Accessibility: ensure role="status" aria-live="polite" for non-interactive toasts. For actionable toasts (Undo/Retry) use role="alertdialog"? Elena: I'd rather keep actionable toasts as non-modal but expose actions via buttons in the toast and ensure they are reachable via keyboard. Alertdialog is heavy and traps focus. Elena: Example for non-interactive toast: ```
Saved
``` Sam: Example for actionable toast (no focus trap): ```
Upload failed
``` Theo: QA note: when modal open + toast shown, test keyboard flow: tabbing should remain within modal, tooltips and toasts must not hijack focus. Also verify Esc closes modal first, not toast. a11y-bot: created ticket #A11-599: modal-toast interaction QA. Steps: 1) open modal, 2) trigger toast, 3) press Esc (modal should close), 4) Tab cycle remains inside modal, 5) screen reader reads toast via live region only. Nina: Action items: Sam to add `dismissOnEsc` flag and stopPropagation checks, Theo to patch focus handler and stacking checks, Elena to update Figma frames with de-emphasized toasts while modal open, a11y-bot to add QA steps. Can we try a preview build tomorrow? Sam: Yep, will spike PR today and aim for preview by EOD. Theo: I'll also add a short note in the component docs about not programmatically focusing the primary action after toast dismiss. Elena: I'll rename spacing.compact-* tokens to spacing.density.compact-* in the Figma tokens page so ingesters have clearer names. a11y-bot: Reminder: include prefers-reduced-motion checks and voiceover/NVDA steps in the QA ticket. Nina: Thanks all 44d I'll update the prototype and ping when ready.
